text: What a Week 5 redemption arc for Drake Maye and the Patriots, who dismantled the Raiders 45-17 despite operating without their top receiver and both starting cornerbacks—a decimation of their secondary that would normally spell disaster. Maye accounted for five total touchdowns against Las Vegas, signaling that he's finally found both his confidence and his deep ball after what sounds like a shaky opening to his season, though the victory came at a cost as RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) and LT Will Campbell (knee sprain) both departed Sunday's game at Gillette Stadium. It's a particularly cruel irony that a dominant performance—one that vindicated Maye's development despite mounting injuries—only added to New England's mounting injury concerns heading into the following week. The Patriots wore throwbacks for the occasion, a perfectly vintage touch to accompany what amounts to a crucial statement win: when healthy enough to take the field, this team can still impose its will against anyone.
